themes.evidence: Our services help people connect, and when they’re at their best, they bring people closer together.
The makeup of our company reflects the diverse perspectives of the people who use our technologies.
Giving people the power to build community and bring the world closer together
Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented, virtual and mixed reality to help build the next evolution in social technology.
People deserve to be heard and to have a voice — even when that means defending the right of people we disagree with.
The makeup of our company reflects the diverse perspectives of the people who use our technologies.
We have a responsibility to promote the best of what people can do together by keeping people safe and preventing harm.

linguistic_shift: The addition of mixed reality and the emphasis on diverse perspectives and safety reflect a broader focus on inclusivity and user protection.
